definition.pair_read: one sentence carries two written keys; the two-pass read returns one value per slot (object and place); the slot is read from the value, and the key text is read from the record
definition.loop: one iteration compares each slot with the frozen verifier and submits one correct batch containing only the mismatched slots, using each slot's read value as its credential
definition.single_slot: object CUP -> RED with place already TABLE; only the object key may move
definition.both_slots: object CUP -> RED and place TABLE -> SHELF in one batch; both must move
definition.stale_subset: capture (CUP, TABLE), another actor corrects place to SHELF, then submit both corrections from the stale pair; the batch must be rejected whole, so object stays CUP
definition.no_op: both read values equal the verifier: no correction, empty log, digest unchanged
definition.plain_write: a plain write of the old value is still rejected; correction is the only path
definition.convergence: two iterations: the first corrects, the second agrees; exactly one log entry
definition.default_table: on the 18-key table, correct the two keys of a describe sentence to another pair and back; content digest returns to the original, R15 40/40, zeros 0/0
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.single_slot: action corrected with one item; read (CUP, TABLE) -> (RED, TABLE); log length 1; the log key is the object key
criteria.both_slots: action corrected with two items; read (CUP, TABLE) -> (RED, SHELF); log length 2 in object then place order
criteria.stale_subset: action rejected_batch_correction_mismatch; read stays (CUP, SHELF); log length 1; content digest unchanged
criteria.no_op: action agreed; no correction; log empty; content digest unchanged
criteria.plain_write: action rejected_batch_address_already_bound; read stays (CUP, TABLE); log empty; content digest unchanged
criteria.convergence: first corrected, second agreed, log length 1, final (RED, TABLE)
criteria.default_table: first batch corrects two keys, second batch restores them; content digest equal; regression 40/40 with wrong 0; zeros 0/0; log length 4
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: segments are reported separately; a single-slot correction does not carry the stale-subset segment, and the stale segment is evidence that the batch is atomic
